what: m20-exit-lever-sweep writes corpus commits onto ARBITRARY claude/** feature branches. MEASURED 2026-10-03: go-live PR #14673 (claude/tradeify-wire-golive) received bot commit e460e64c2 'corpus: merge exit-lever sweep run 2026-10-03T17:02Z' (48 rows of docs/research/m20-sweep-corpus.jsonl rewritten) from run 37138828225, event=push. Cause: .github/workflows/m20-exit-lever-sweep.yml has `push: branches: ['claude/**'], paths: ['.github/exit-lever-sweep-request']`; a feature branch that MERGES main after main changed that sentinel (here #15726, carried by merge c4843093d) fires the workflow, and its corpus job pushes to TARGET=${GITHUB_HEAD_REF:-${GITHUB_REF_NAME}} -- the feature branch. So any lane that merges main can silently get a sweep run plus a corpus commit unrelated to its PR, which can also conflict or ride into a Tier-2/3 merge. Repaired on #14673 by faa4e12bd (file restored to main's). Fix options (Tier-1 CI): only fire the push trigger when the sentinel changed in a commit authored on the branch (e.g. compare github.event.before..after excluding merge-from-main parents), or route every non-dispatch corpus to claude/m20-sweep-corpus instead of the triggering branch.
